_description: Custom Reports scenario — build + preview + save a SESSIONS report over a CUSTOM date range. The builder is a plain form whose state rides in query params (?subject=sessions&filters[rangeMode]=custom&...) — preset range modes disable the date inputs, so custom mode is used whenever the test must control dates. Columns are checkbox ids field-{group}-{key}; keys below are the id suffixes, matched by suffix so they stay stable if a group name changes. Filters are SELECT OPTION TEXTS from staging. saveReport uses DYNAMIC for a unique-per-run name; recipients is required by the server form. Cleanup: the spec deletes the saved report afterwards via its row Delete button (native confirm()).

_config._comment: No extra test parameters — the scenario is the form payload only.
